title: jsonschema-benchmark results
description: The data behind the results site, published as data.json beside it. Every figure is a total over all the instances of a schema: cold is the first validation pass after compilation, warm a later one, compile the preparation of the schema and parse the parsing of every instance from memory, all in nanoseconds; memory is the peak resident set size in KB.

version.description: Raised when the format changes in a way readers must handle.

repo.description: The GitHub repository the results came from, as owner/name.

runUrl.description: The workflow run that produced the results.

date.description: When the site was generated, in ISO 8601.

runner.description: The machines the benchmarks ran on.

runs.description: How many times each implementation ran each schema.

lang.description: The language of its source files; empty when unknown.

bowtie.description: Its Bowtie implementation ID, from implementations/<id>/bowtie, or null when Bowtie does not test it.

dialect.description: The schema's $schema, or null when it declares none.

sizeKb.description: The size of the schema in KB.

avgDoc.description: The average size of an instance in bytes.

results.description: For each implementation ID, the result on each schema it ran: null when any run failed to validate, otherwise one figure per run for each measure.
